prompt_md: Machine A makes 80% of the bolts and 1% of its bolts are faulty. Machine B makes the other 20%, and 4% of its are faulty. A random faulty bolt: chance it came from B?
prompt_short: A: 80% of bolts, 1% faulty. B: 20%, 4% faulty. Faulty bolt from B?
hint_md: Count the faulty bolts in a batch of 1,000.
explain_intuition_md: In 1,000 bolts, A makes 800 and 8 of them are faulty; B makes 200 and 8 of them are faulty. So the faulty bolts are split evenly. B is four times sloppier, which suggests 80%, but A makes four times as many bolts.
